verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents official SDKs across a dozen+ platforms (rollbar.js for web frontend/backend frameworks like React, Angular, Express, Next.js; Ruby, PHP/Magento2, etc.) that automatically capture uncaught errors and exceptions, with telemetry, source map support, and person/version tracking. Cross-platform coverage including client and server-side JS is explicitly confirmed via GitHub repo description. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation naming mobile-specific SDKs (iOS/Android) with auto-capture details, and independent hands-on verification of automatic uncaught-exception capture across all platforms.
